scenes.say: With plain HTTP, only the browser can speak first. Want new messages? Ask. Ask again. And again. That's polling, and it's wasteful.
A WebSocket starts as an ordinary HTTP request that asks to upgrade. The server answers one oh one, switching protocols, and the connection stays open.
From then on, it's a two-way pipe.

items.title: Chat
items.say: Chat messages arrive the moment they're sent.

scenes.say: In the browser, it's three lines. Connect, listen, send.
That's WebSockets. One connection, both directions, no more asking.
